verdict.rationale: Versioning is clearly evidenced. A live probe shows the Global Catalog MCP server returning an `x-shopify-ucp-mcp-api-version: 2026-08-25` header, and the UCP spec publishes dated releases (2026-08-25, 2026-04-08). Agent and business profiles also declare and negotiate protocol versions. Deprecation, however, appears only as a removal notice for the old `/api/mcp` catalog and cart tools, with no documented deprecation policy. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (support windows, sunset timelines, advance-notice commitments), a version lifecycle/support schedule for the UCP MCP APIs, independent corroboration of how breaking changes are handled.
